verdicts.reason: A keeps a readable CTA and a sensible headline/CTA hierarchy. But the whole group is pushed right, leaving the left third as dead orange space. The centred headline sits jammed near the top edge, and the CTA is left-aligned under it, so the two share no clean axis. B's headline is oversized and crammed against the left, top and bottom edges. Its CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill with near-illegible text, wedged against the right edge, so the call to action is effectively buried.
